# Fork watch cursor — read by .github/workflows/check-forks.yml.
#
# One line per fork: "<owner>/<repo> <full commit sha>". Everything up to and
# including that commit has been reviewed by a human (ported, or deliberately
# skipped), so the weekly check only reports commits made after it. Without
# this, a fork whose work we ported by hand (different SHAs) or whose history
# predates a rewrite of ours gets re-reported in full every week.
#
# After reviewing a fork-watch issue: set the fork's line to its current tip
# (`git ls-remote https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> HEAD`), then close the issue.

# Qwen + Gemini source-inline-chip ported in #30 (f963997); the rest is our
# own pre-rewrite history.
